description: This file contains a comprehensive suite of PHPUnit tests for the Generator component of the Confluence formatter within the Daux documentation generator project. It tests various aspects of the generator, including configuration validation, page creation, content publishing, attachment handling, and deletion of obsolete pages, ensuring the robustness and correctness of the Confluence integration.

classes.name: GeneratorTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the Generator's functionality within the Confluence formatter of the Daux project. It verifies configuration handling, page creation/updating, attachment uploads, and deletion logic.

methods.name: testConfiguration
methods.description: Tests the validation of Confluence-specific configuration options.

methods.name: configurationTestProvider
methods.description: Provides various sets of configuration data and expected error messages for testing configuration validation.

methods.name: testPublishAllPages
methods.description: Validates the successful publishing of a full page hierarchy to Confluence.

methods.name: testUpdatePublishedPages
methods.description: Ensures that existing pages are correctly updated without unnecessary modifications.

methods.name: testDeletePages
methods.description: Tests the deletion of obsolete pages when the 'delete' option is enabled.

methods.name: testWarnAboutDelete
methods.description: Checks that the system correctly warns about pages that would be deleted when deletion is disabled.

methods.name: testFindRootByAncestor
methods.description: Verifies that the generator can find or create the root page based on an ancestor ID.

methods.name: testCreateRootAndPublishAllPages
methods.description: Tests creation of the root page when it does not exist and subsequent publishing.

methods.name: testCreateRootWithSiblingSpaceAndPublishAllPages
methods.description: Checks root page creation when other pages exist at the same ancestor level.

methods.name: testRootNotFound
methods.description: Verifies the proper exception is thrown if the root page cannot be found and creation is not permitted.

methods.name: testRootNotFoundButFoundSiblings
methods.description: Ensures the correct exception is thrown if a page with the expected name is missing but siblings exist.

methods.name: testPublishAttachments
methods.description: Tests the upload of attachments, especially images, during page publishing.

methods.name: testMixed
methods.description: Simulates a complex scenario with updates, creations, deletions, and attachments, and verifies the dry-run (print_diff) behavior.
